mechanism: Sulfamethoxazole may inhibit CYP2D6 metabolism of perphenazine, increasing perphenazine levels; additive photosensitivity risk and potential for increased anticholinergic effects.
action: Monitor for increased perphenazine side effects including extrapyramidal symptoms, anticholinergic effects, and photosensitivity; consider dose adjustment if adverse effects occur; advise sun protection.
